About timeline: 1991 'Johnnie launches Boden with a mail-order catalogue containing just eight products', drawn 'on his kitchen table in West London'; nav links Petite and Tall collections (https://us.boden.com/pages/about-us).
Wikipedia: HQ North Acton, London; founded 1991 by Johnnie Boden; US website since 2002, the US is its largest market (45% of 2024 sales) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boden_(clothing)).
Returns: 'within 45 days of receipt', unworn, unwashed, tags attached; no fee stated (https://us.boden.com/policies/refund-policy). Free-shipping threshold not found (shipping-policy URL 404).
